name: Instruo Seashell
firmware: Seashell firmware 1.0.3 (the firmware page's latest; no date given); Seashell Controller 1.0.0; firmware 2.0 announced (secondary), not released

midiIn.connector: 3.5 mm TRS type A MIDI in (the included adaptor) and class-compliant USB-C audio + MIDI; input only
midiIn.note: DIN-to-TRS type A adapter from the Thru5 WC.

clock.syncs: nothing: no MIDI clock; the only sync is the analogue Gate/Trig input (Tap Tempo menu)

channelSetting: Seashell Controller app > Settings > MIDI Channel Menu = 1 (saved automatically since 1.0.3).

channel.note: Set in the Seashell Controller software (Settings > MIDI Channel). TRS type A MIDI in and class-compliant USB-C. Default and omni not documented. Wrong Room: channel 1.

programChange.note: Not supported in the published firmware 1.0.x (presets are files of the Controller app). Firmware 2.0 (announced, not on Instruo's site) is said to add 120 preset slots selected by program change; numbering and bank scheme unknown.

controllers.name: No fixed CC map: parameters are assigned by MIDI Learn in the Controller app; any CC 0..127 can be a modulation-matrix source

setup: Map the parameters you want to drive with MIDI Learn (the mapping is yours; enter the CC numbers in the rig profile).
No program change in firmware 1.0.3: a song can only send CCs you learnt; keep an eye on firmware 2.0 (120 preset slots by program change, announced).
notes: Secondary: a user-made default CC map exists (Electra One preset); not a factory assignment.

sources.title: Seashell user manual (2025, firmware 1.0.0): TRS type A in, USB-C, MIDI Channel Menu, MIDI Learn, no clock
Instruo firmware page (1.0.3 notes: revised MIDI stack, channel saved automatically)
